name: web_search
description: Search the web for current information. Use when the user asks about news, facts, weather, or anything requiring up-to-date knowledge. Call this ONCE per unique query and report what you find — do not re-search the same topic with slightly different queries if the results are not detailed enough. The ONLY accepted parameters are 'query' (the search string) and 'max_results' (number of results, default 5, max 10). No other parameters are supported.

max_results.description: Number of results to return (default 5, max 10)
